sources.title: mimi: Audio-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Mimi is a high-fidelity audio neural codec developed by kyutai that compresses speech into audio tokens running at 12.5Hz with a bitrate of 1.1kbps. The model uses a streaming encoder-decoder architecture with a quantized latent space trained end-to-end on speech data, making it particularly suited for training speech language models or text-to-speech systems. sources.title: Mimi · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mimi is a neural audio codec model with pretrained and quantized variants, designed for efficient speech representation and compression. The model operates at 1.1 kbps with a 12 Hz frame rate and uses a convolutional encoder-decoder architecture combined with a residual vector quantizer of 16 codebooks. sources.snippet: MimiModel Relevant source files MimiModel is the audio codec component of Pocket TTS, serving a dual role as both an audio encoder and decoder. It encodes audio prompts into latent representations for voice cloning and decodes generated latents back into PCM audio.
